description: Unified AEGIS AI OS Tool Registry across agent frameworks

tools.name: terminal
tools.capability: Execute shell commands, run scripts, manage processes on the host machine
tools.description: Run shell commands on the host machine with configurable timeout and workdir

tools.name: file_read
tools.capability: Read any file on the filesystem with slice offsets
tools.description: Read any file on the filesystem

tools.name: file_write
tools.capability: Write or overwrite files in the workspace or vault
tools.description: Create new files or overwrite existing content

tools.name: file_patch
tools.capability: Apply surgical non-contiguous patches and diff replacements
tools.description: Apply targeted regex or exact-match replacements to source files

tools.name: file_search
tools.capability: Fast ripgrep text and regex search across directory trees
tools.description: Search code and markdown notes across directories with glob filters

tools.name: browser
tools.capability: Navigate web pages, inspect DOM, take screenshots, extract content
tools.description: Headless browser automation for research, verification, and testing

tools.name: execute_code
tools.capability: Execute code snippets in Python, Node.js, and Bash sandboxes
tools.description: Execute isolated code blocks and evaluate output

tools.name: memory_store
tools.capability: Query, update, and index Obsidian PARA memory files and MOCs
tools.description: Manage long-term knowledge in Obsidian vault and profile memories

tools.name: delegate_task
tools.capability: Spawn independent subagent threads with specialized prompts
tools.description: Delegate tasks to background subagents with reactive wakeup

tools.name: vision_analyze
tools.capability: Analyze UI screenshots, diagrams, and images with vision models
tools.description: Inspect visual assets and evaluate UI layouts
